paired_errors.caption: Paired displacement errors on eight original development trajectories. Both estimators receive identical reconstructed own/one-hop scans and original initialization metadata, with candidate-specific admission and internal state. MAE uses times when both team estimates are available; the candidate is available at all originally available evaluation times in this batch. Frames and local readouts are not independent trials; these are not closed-loop improvements.

far_goal_readouts.caption: Goal-distance estimates and evaluation truth on the original C and skew-box trajectories. All recorded physical times are shown without smoothing; NaNs are gaps. Dotted lines mark the original controller HOLD, not a candidate stopping event. The offline candidate rejects the original skew-box position gate at that time, but its subsequent closed-loop trajectory and completion were not executed.
